prediction.likelyOutcome: GSL is very likely to obtain judgment against both the tenant and Nguyen individually (as tenant/guarantor) close to the $132,139.24 total requested in its pending, unopposed summary judgment motion, with the principal rent/fee, clean-out, and interest components largely intact and the attorney's fee component subject to some reduction if billing support is thin. The chief uncertainty is Nguyen's unquantified lockout/conversion claim, which appears weak under a peaceable-repossession analysis but has not been fully vetted for what happened to the removed equipment.

issues.label: Unpaid Rent, CAM and Other Lease Charges Through Termination

outcome.description: On September 4, 2025 the trial court granted the landlord summary judgment for $132,139.24, exactly the sum itemized in the landlord's affidavit ($104,295.80 overdue rent and fees, $3,000 clean-out costs, $12,416.92 prejudgment interest, $12,010.52 attorneys' fees and $416 court costs), plus 8 percent post-judgment interest and collection fees; the amount recorded here is the judgment less the $12,010.52 in attorneys' fees. The Twelfth District affirmed on July 27, 2026, holding the guarantor forfeited his lockout, notarization and phantom-LLC arguments by not opposing the motion.
